appended_meaning:
The materially referenced health-care funding conditions are compared across all four original requirements Acts, at complete selected clauses rather than an unqualified shorthand ban. PL113-235 division G 2015, PL115-31 division H 2017, PL116-94 division A 2020 and PL117-328 division H 2023 each preserve complete section 3 and sections 506-507. Section 3 treats a reference to 'this Act' in any division as referring only to that division's provisions, except as expressly provided otherwise. The operative LHHS division header is source-bound for each version, rather than its table of contents, another division's foreign-assistance rules or an assumed whole-consolidated-Act scope. These remain requirements-source objects invoked by the established health-transfer chain; the exact continuing direction and dated source application scopes are not discarded or decided into a universal individual rule here.

Complete 506(a)-(b) bars expenditure of both funds appropriated in the relevant Act/division and funds in any trust fund to which funds are appropriated in that Act/division for abortion and for health-benefits coverage that includes abortion. Complete 506(c) defines health-benefits coverage as a managed-care provider or organization's package of services under a contract or other arrangement. The funding and defined-coverage conditions are distinct; this is not every private medical expense, every possible form of health care, all immigration assistance or a new nationwide criminal prohibition. No actual expenditure, provider contract, individual service, coverage determination or violation is found.

Complete 507(a) retains both exceptions to the preceding section's limitations: pregnancy resulting from rape or incest; or a physical disorder, injury or illness, including a pregnancy-caused or pregnancy-arising life-endangering physical condition, that a physician certifies would place the woman in danger of death unless an abortion is performed. The physician certification and danger-of-death predicate remain with the full physical-condition context. Neither exception is dropped, expanded to every health concern, limited to only one offense or presumed satisfied by an individual trafficking-victim label. These are qualified source conditions, not a prediction or determination about a particular pregnancy or service recipient.

Complete 507(b) reserves expenditure by a State, locality, entity or private person of State, local or private funds, with the express exception for a State's or locality's Medicaid matching contribution. Complete 507(c) separately preserves managed-care providers' ability to offer abortion coverage and State/local ability to contract separately with a provider for such coverage using State funds, again excluding State/local Medicaid matching contributions. These source reservations are not silently removed, treated as permission to use the covered Federal/trust funds without conditions or converted into a guarantee of separate coverage or funding.

Complete 507(d) conditions availability of funds made available in the Act/division to a Federal agency/program or State/local government on whether that body subjects an institutional or individual health-care entity to discrimination because it does not provide, pay for, cover or refer for abortions. All four listed refusal grounds remain; the condition is not only refusal to perform a procedure, every grant recipient's personal behavior or a finding that any named government/provider discriminated. Complete entity context includes physicians and other health professionals, hospitals, provider-sponsored organizations, HMOs, health-insurance plans and other health-care facilities/organizations/plans. No individual provider status, enforcement result, new immigration eligibility or motive is inferred.

All four original versions contain matching operative conditions at this reviewed extent, while their dates, division identities, annotations, page markers and glyphs remain distinct and unchanged. That bounded comparison does not merge the Acts into one unqualified version, create four independent member actions or decide all dated carry-forward applications. The member-neutral meaning remains context for the whole H.R. 1968 passage choice, without attributing a separate abortion position or intent from this package vote. Existing shared compacts, recorded choices, counting, eligibility and program/medical/child-service qualifications remain unchanged.

This completes only the selected 506-507 health-care restrictions/exceptions/conditional entity requirements and their section 3/division scope across four underlying Acts. Other materially relevant program, HHS and general provisions remain executable research, including qualified availability, lobbying, embryo/drug/identifier and administrative conditions at their actual scope. No final universal rider set, individual coverage/grant/cohort judgment, full fund/package/domain closure, independent acceptance or publication is declared. All 70 separate application questions, including frozen Q68/Q69/Q70, remain unchanged; other package authorities, counterparts, ordinary screenings and final comparison continue.

SEC. 3. <<NOTE: 1 USC 1 note.>> REFERENCES. Except as expressly provided otherwise, any reference to ``this Act'' contained in any division of this Act shall be treated as referring only to the provisions of that division. 

DIVISION G--DEPARTMENTS <<NOTE: Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2015. Department of Labor Appropriations Act, 2015.>> OF LABOR, HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, AND EDUCATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015 

Sec. 506. (a) None of the funds appropriated in this Act, and none of the funds in any trust fund to which funds are appropriated in this Act, shall be expended for any abortion. (b) None of the funds appropriated in this Act, and none of the funds in any trust fund to which funds are appropriated in this Act, shall be expended for health benefits coverage that includes coverage of abortion. (c) The term ``health benefits coverage'' means the package of services covered by a managed care provider or organization pursuant to a contract or other arrangement. Sec. 507. (a) The limitations established in the preceding section shall not apply to an abortion-- (1) if the pregnancy is the result of an act of rape or incest; or (2) in the case where a woman suffers from a physical disorder, physical injury, or physical illness, including a life-endangering physical condition caused by or arising from the pregnancy itself, that would, as certified by a physician, place the woman in danger of death unless an abortion is performed. (b) Nothing in the preceding section shall be construed as prohibiting the expenditure by a State, locality, entity, or private person of State, local, or private funds (other than a State's or locality's contribution of Medicaid matching funds). (c) Nothing in the preceding section shall be construed as restricting the ability of any managed care provider from offering abortion coverage or the ability of a State or locality to contract separately with such a provider for such coverage with State funds (other than a State's or locality's contribution of Medicaid matching funds). (d)(1) None of the funds made available in this Act may be made available to a Federal agency or program, or to a State or local government, if such agency, program, or government subjects any institutional or individual health care entity to discrimination on the basis that the health care entity does not provide, pay for, provide coverage of, or refer for abortions. (2) In this subsection, the term ``health care entity'' includes an individual physician or other health care professional, a hospital, a provider-sponsored organization, a health maintenance organization, a health insurance plan, or any other kind of health care facility, organization, or plan.
